label: Watercraft
description: Boats and ships, from canoes and traditional sailing vessels to ferries, cargo ships, and submarines.
frame: a view of the ___ on the water
notes: Generic boat and ship types belong here, including human-powered craft, traditional hulls, working ships, and naval vessels. vehicle.aircraft owns seaplanes; vehicle.spacecraft owns fictional space freighters rather than seagoing ships. Values are bare vessel names without manufacturers, individual ship names, flags, or occupants. Sail and traditional chips can overlap, and preserved historical vessels remain available in contemporary scenes.
